title: Trump reverts to an old theme, warns of immigrant caravans
description: President Donald Trump blended two of his frequent topics, immigration and tariffs.

title: Trump says no deal needed with Iran, closes down Vance negotiations
description: The president suggested Thursday that he was dialing back diplomatic efforts to end the conflict with Iran and ending a dealmaking effort by the vice president.

title: New House Intelligence Committee chair plans ‘aggressive’ oversight of CIA
description: Rep. Jim Himes (D-Connecticut) said that the agency has expanded covert action and needed more supervision as such.

title: A new congressman on the blue wave, 2028 and what Democrats should prioritize
description: With the size of the Democrats' House majority comes incredible pressure, a Connecticut congressman-elect says.

title: Democratic sweep opens the door for major policy changes at state level
description: Democrats gained trifectas in six new states, flipped 12 state legislative chambers and are poised to flip six governorships.

title: Colom wins Mississippi Senate race. And, White House warns Dems over future probes
description: After more than a week of counting ballots, Scott Colom has narrowly won the Mississippi Senate seat. And, the White House has sent a letter warning Democrats who plan to investigate the administration.

title: At least 23 states considered laws governing ICE and schools this year
description: When ICE agents show up at a school, educators rely on a patchwork of policies to know what to do. This year, many state legislatures tried to update those policies.

title: A blue wave helped offset for now a falling tally of Black members in the U.S. House
description: A Supreme Court ruling that further weakened the Voting Rights Act paved the way for a record drop in Black representation in Congress. But a midterm blue wave helped hold off such a decline for now.

title: How Scott Colom defied the odds to go from DA to Mississippi's Democratic U.S. Senator
description: In a state that hasn't had a Democrat in office since 1980 and hasn't sent a Black Senator to Washington since the 1870s, Colom's win represents a massive upset in state politics.

title: Senators don't always share bill text online before votes. They should, advocates say
description: The text of what lawmakers are considering isn't always made available for public review before it is voted on. A group of open governance advocates is calling on Senate leadership for a change.

title: Rep. Bennie Thompson discusses the U.S. Senate race Democrat win in Mississippi
description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Democratic Representative Bennie Thompson, of Mississippi, about Democrat Scott Colom's U.S. Senate victory.

title: Democrat Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate race
description: Scott Colom has won the U.S. Senate race in Mississippi. After a very close race, he's the first Black man to represent the state in the Senate in nearly 150 years.

title: Michigan Senator-elect El Sayed discusses Democrats' ambitions
description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with U.S. Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed (D-Mich.) about his win in the midterms and what's at the top of his agenda once he begins his first term in Congress.

title: White House warns Trump probes could be criminal. Rep. Robert Garcia won't back down

title: Democrat Scott Colom wins Senate race in Mississippi
